definitions.Draft: Planned only, not implemented or intentionally deferred.
definitions.Partially-Shipped: Shell or partial runtime exists, backend/data integration incomplete.
definitions.Shipped: Route/component works and is connected to expected contracts for its stage.
definitions.Existing: Infrastructure exists outside this repo or as a shared service.
definitions.Blocked: Cannot proceed without dependency or unresolved failure.

rule: Frontend shells with mock data are Partially-Shipped, not Shipped.
